project.name: nextjs-portfolio-blog-research
project.description: Next.js 16 portfolio and blog site with App Router, next-intl, MDX-style blog content, SEO helpers, and optional analytics integrations.

runtime.lint_command: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:deps && pnpm lint:quality

GA4_PROPERTY_ID.purpose: Google Analytics 4 property ID used by src/app/api/analytics/route.ts.

GA4_CLIENT_EMAIL.purpose: Google service account client email used server-side by the analytics API route.

GA4_PRIVATE_KEY.purpose: Google service account private key used server-side by the analytics API route.

NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID.purpose: Google Tag Manager container ID for client-side script injection.

VERCEL_ENV.purpose: Vercel deployment environment flag used to enable Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights.

todos: Add a test runner if future changes need automated unit or component tests.
Document any intentionally locale-specific blog slugs before relaxing parity checks.
